sentences: Everyone laughed at the woman who sued McDonald's over hot coffee.
Stella Liebeck, age seventy-nine, spilled a cup in her lap.
McDonald's served its coffee at up to one hundred ninety degrees.
At that heat, it can cause third-degree burns in under three seconds.
Her sweatpants soaked it up and held it against her skin.
Eight days in the hospital. Skin grafts.
She only wanted her medical bills paid.
Then a number came out: over seven hundred burn complaints, before hers.
The jury awarded two point seven million.
A judge cut it to four hundred eighty thousand.
Not a frivolous lawsuit. Seven hundred warnings.
